Action 05役付回付 [click]:
Sub Click(Source As Button)
	On Error Goto ERR_TRAP
	Dim ws				As NotesUIWorkspace
	Dim uidoc			As NotesUIDocument
	Dim doc			As NotesDocument
	Dim strStatusCode	As String
	Dim strRetMsg		As String
	Dim blnSEM		As Boolean
	Dim blnRes			As Boolean
	Dim intRes			As Integer
	Dim varStatusRet	As Variant
	strRetMsg = funcReturnMsg( "Q001" )
	intRes = Msgbox( strRetMsg, 4 + 32 + 256, "確認" )
	If intRes = 7 Then
		strRetMsg = funcReturnMsg( "I001" )
		Msgbox strRetMsg, 0 + 64,"確認"
		Exit Sub
	Else
	End If
	Set ws			= New NotesUIWorkspace
	Set uidoc		= ws.CurrentDocument
	Set doc			= uidoc.Document
	If funcChangeDocMode(uidoc, True) = False Then
		Exit Sub
	Else
	End If
	doc.BtnFlag = "1"
	If funcBirthField( uidoc ) = False Then
		doc.BtnFlag = "0"
		Exit Sub
	End If
	blnSEM = funcErrChkDan( uidoc )
	If blnSEM = False Then
		doc.BtnFlag = "0"
		Exit Sub
	Else
	End If
	blnRes = funcChkDocSize( doc, 300 )
	If blnRes = False Then
		doc.BtnFlag = "0"
		Call uidoc.GotoField("AttatchDoc1")
		strRetMsg = funcReturnMsg("E010")
		Msgbox strRetMsg, 0 + 16,"エラー"
		Exit Sub
	Else
	End If
	strStatusCode = doc.StatusCode(0)
	varStatusRet = funcWfStatGet( strStatusCode, 1 )
	If varStatusRet(0) = "" Then
		doc.BtnFlag = "0"
		strRetMsg = funcReturnMsg( "E021" )
		Msgbox strRetMsg, 0 + 16, "エラー"
		Exit Sub
	End If
	doc.StatusCode = varStatusRet(0)
	doc.StatusName = varStatusRet(1)
	blnSEM = funcUpdateRireki( doc, varStatusRet(0) )
	If blnSEM = False Then
		doc.SaveOptions = "0"
		Call uidoc.Close( False )
		Exit Sub
	Else
	End If
	If funcSaveConflictCheck(doc) = False Then
		doc.SaveOptions = "0"
	Else
		doc.SaveOptions = "1"
		Call uidoc.Save
	End If
	Call uidoc.Close( False )
	Exit Sub
ERR_TRAP:
	strRetMsg = funcReturnMsg( "E020" )
	Msgbox strRetMsg & Chr(13) & Chr(10) & Chr(13) & Chr(10) & _
	funcOnErrorMsg("役付回付_Click",Err, Erl, Error$), 16, "システムエラー"
	If doc Is Nothing Then
	Else
		doc.SaveOptions = "0"
		Call uidoc.Close( False )
	End If
	Exit Sub
End Sub

	Dim doc			As NotesDocument

	Dim itmIraiDate	As NotesItem
	Dim strStatusCode	As String
	Dim strRetMsg		As String
	Dim strBirthDay	As String
	Dim strDefDate	As String
	Dim blnSEM		As Boolean
	Dim intRes			As Integer
	Dim intAgeRet		As Integer
	Dim varStatusRet	As Variant

		Exit Sub
	Else
	End If
	Set ws			= New NotesUIWorkspace
	Set uidoc		= ws.CurrentDocument
	Set doc			= uidoc.Document
	g_blnBtnEditFlag = True
	If funcChangeDocMode(uidoc, True) = False Then
		Exit Sub
	Else
	End If
	doc.BtnFlag = "1"

		doc.BtnFlag = "0"
		strRetMsg = funcReturnMsg( "E021" )

		Exit Sub
	End If
	doc.StatusCode = varStatusRet(0)
	doc.StatusName = varStatusRet(1)
	blnSEM = funcUpdateRireki( doc, varStatusRet(0) )
	If blnSEM = False Then
		doc.SaveOptions = "0"
		Call uidoc.Close( False )
		Exit Sub
	Else
	End If
	Call uidoc.Refresh
	If funcSaveConflictCheck(doc) = False Then
		doc.SaveOptions = "0"
	Else
		Call uidoc.Save
	End If
	Call uidoc.Close( False )
	Exit Sub
ERR_TRAP:
	strRetMsg = funcReturnMsg( "E020" )
	Msgbox strRetMsg & Chr(13) & Chr(10) & Chr(13) & Chr(10) & _
	funcOnErrorMsg("依頼送付_Click",Err, Erl, Error$), 16, "システムエラー"

Form Script[onsubmit]: Sub Onsubmit(Source As Notesuidocument, Continue As Variant)
	On Error Goto ERR_TRAP
	Dim strBtnFlag		As String
	Dim doc			As NotesDocument
	Set doc				= Source.Document
	If funcBirthField( Source ) = False Then
		Continue = False
		Exit Sub
	End If
	strBtnFlag = doc.BtnFlag(0)
	If strBtnFlag = "1" Then
		doc.BtnFlag = "0"
		Exit Sub
	Else
		doc.SaveOptions = "1"
		Continue = True
	End If
	Dim ss				As NotesSession
	Dim db				As NotesDatabase
	Dim strFullName	As String
	Dim strTime		As String
	Dim strName		As String
	Dim strEigyoDay	As String
	Dim intStatus		As Integer
	Dim intLimitSize	As Integer
	Dim blnRes			As Boolean
	Dim strRetMsg		As String
	Set ss				= New NotesSession
	Set db				= ss.CurrentDatabase
	Set doc				= Source.Document
	Continue = True
	blnRes = funcChkDocSize( doc, 300 )
	If blnRes = False Then
		Select Case doc.StatusCode(0)
		Case "1000","2000"
			Call Source.GotoField("AttatchDoc1")
		Case "5000"
			Call Source.GotoField("AttatchDoc2")
		Case Else
		End Select
		strRetMsg = funcReturnMsg("E010")
		Msgbox strRetMsg, 0 + 16,"エラー"
		Continue = False
		Exit Sub
	Else
	End If
	If funcSaveConflictCheck(doc) = False Then
		Continue = False
	Else
	End If
	Exit Sub
ERR_TRAP:
	strRetMsg = funcReturnMsg( "E020" )
	Msgbox strRetMsg & Chr(13) & Chr(10) & Chr(13) & Chr(10) & _
	funcOnErrorMsg("Onsubmit",Err, Erl, Error$), 16, "システムエラー発生"
	Continue = False
	Exit Sub
End Sub

Form Script[querymodechange]: Sub Querymodechange(Source As Notesuidocument, Continue As Variant)
	On Error Goto ERR_TRAP
	Dim doc		As NotesDocument
	Dim blnSEM	As Boolean
	Dim blnRet		As Boolean
	Dim strStatus	As String
	Dim strRetMsg	As String
	Set doc			= Source.Document
	blnSEM = True
	Continue = False
	strStatus = doc.StatusCode(0)
	If ( strStatus ="2500" Or strStatus ="3000" Or strStatus ="4000" Or strStatus = "7000" )_
	And (g_blnBtnEditFlag <> False) Then
		Continue = True
	Else
		blnSEM = funcChkEditDoc ( strStatus, blnRet )
		If blnSEM = False Then
			Exit Sub
		Else
			If blnRet = True Then
				Continue = True
			Else
				Continue = False
			End If
		End If
	End If
	Exit Sub
ERR_TRAP:
	strRetMsg = funcReturnMsg( "E020" )
	Msgbox strRetMsg & Chr(13) & Chr(10) & Chr(13) & Chr(10) & _
	funcOnErrorMsg("Querymodechange",Err, Erl, Error$), 16, "システムエラー"
	Call Source.Close( False )
	Exit Sub
End Sub

Form Event [onsubmit]:
Sub Onsubmit(Source As Notesuidocument, Continue As Variant)
	On Error Goto ERR_HANDLE
	Dim objAddInfo		As clsAddressInfo
	Dim doc			As NotesDocument
	Dim blnRes			As Boolean
	Dim strTime		As String
	Dim strUserID		As String
	Dim nmUserID		As NotesName
	Dim strRetMsg		As String
	Set objAddInfo = New clsAddressInfo("")
	Set doc			= Source.Document
	Continue = True
	blnRes = funcErrChkDate( Source )
	If blnRes = False Then
		Continue = False
		Exit Sub
	Else
		strTime = Format$( Today, "yyyy/mm/dd" )
		If objAddInfo.InfoFlag = True Then
			Set nmUserID = New NotesName( objAddInfo.UserID )
			strUserID = nmUserID.Abbreviated
		Else
			strRetMsg = funcReturnMsg( "E019" )
			Msgbox strRetMsg, 0 + 16, "システムエラー"
			Continue = False
			Exit Sub
		End If
		doc.UpdtDate = strTime
		doc.UpdtUser = strUserID
	End If
	Exit Sub
ERR_HANDLE:
	strRetMsg = funcReturnMsg( "E020" )
	Msgbox strRetMsg & Chr(13) & Chr(10) & Chr(13) & Chr(10) & _
	funcOnErrorMsg("Onsubmit",Err, Erl, Error$), 16, "システムエラー"
	If doc Is Nothing Then
	Else
		doc.SaveOptions = "0"
		Call Source.Close( False )
	End If
	Exit Sub
End Sub

Form Script[options]:
Option Public
Option Declare
Use "libCommon"
Use "clsAddressInfo"
Use "libErrorCheck"

Form Script[funcErrChkDate]: Function funcErrChkDate ( uidoc As NotesUIDocument ) As Boolean
	On Error Goto ERR_HANDLE
	Dim doc			As NotesDocument
	Dim blnRet 		As Boolean
	Dim blnSEM		As Boolean
	Dim strRetMsg		As String
	Set doc			= uidoc.Document
	funcErrChkDate = True
	Forall item In doc.SyukuDay
		blnSEM = funcChkDate( item, blnRet )
		If blnSEM = False Then
			Exit Function
		End If
		If blnRet = False Then
			strRetMsg = funcReturnMsg( "E011" )
			Msgbox strRetMsg, 0 + 16, "エラー"
			Call uidoc.GotoField("SyukuDay")
			funcErrChkDate = False
			Exit Function
		End If
	End Forall
	blnRet = True
	Exit Function
ERR_HANDLE:
	funcErrChkDate = False
	strRetMsg = funcReturnMsg( "E020" )
	Msgbox strRetMsg & Chr(13) & Chr(10) & Chr(13) & Chr(10) & _
	funcOnErrorMsg("funcErrChkDate",Err, Erl, Error$), 16, "システムエラー"
	Exit Function
End Function

Form Script[funcErrChkMente]: Function funcErrChkMente( uidoc As NotesUIDocument ,blnErrRes As Boolean ) As Boolean
	On Error Goto ERR_TRAP
	Dim strErrMsg				As String
	Dim strSortNo				As String
	Dim strSelection			As String
	Dim strErrList				List As String
	Dim intCount				As Integer
	funcErrChkMente	= True
	blnErrRes			= True
	Erase				strErrList
	intCount			= 0
	strErrMsg			= "以下のエラーが発生しました。確認してください。" & Chr(13) & Chr(10)
	strSortNo = uidoc.FieldGetText( "SortNo" )
	If strSortNo = "" Then
		strErrMsg = strErrMsg & Chr(13) & Chr(10) & "ソート順を入力してください"
		strErrList( intCount ) = "SortNo"
		intCount = intCount + 1
		blnErrRes = False
	Else
		If  Len( strSortNo ) <> Lenbp( strSortNo ) Then
			strErrMsg = strErrMsg & Chr(13) & Chr(10) & "ソート順は、半角英数字3文字で入力してください"
			strErrList( intCount ) = "SortNo"
			intCount = intCount + 1
			blnErrRes = False
		Elseif  strSortNo Like "*[!0-9]*"And strSortNo Like "*[!a-z,A-Z]*" Then
			strErrMsg = strErrMsg & Chr(13) & Chr(10) & "ソート順は、半角英数字3文字で入力してください"
			strErrList( intCount ) = "SortNo"
			intCount = intCount + 1
			blnErrRes = False
		Elseif Len( strSortNo ) <> 3 Then
			strErrMsg = strErrMsg & Chr(13) & Chr(10) & "ソート順は、半角英数字3文字で入力してください"
			strErrList( intCount ) = "SortNo"
			intCount = intCount + 1
			blnErrRes = False
		Else
		End If
	End If
	strSelection = uidoc.FieldGetText( "Selection" )
	If strSelection = "" Then
		strErrMsg = strErrMsg & Chr(13) & Chr(10) & "選択肢項目内容を入力してください"
		strErrList( intCount ) = "Selection"
		intCount = intCount + 1
		blnErrRes = False
	End If
	If blnErrRes = False Then
		Msgbox strErrMsg, 0 + 16, "エラー"
		Call uidoc.GotoField( strErrList(0) )
	End If
	Exit Function
ERR_TRAP:
	funcErrChkMente = False
	Msgbox funcOnErrorMsg("funcErrChkMente", Err, Erl, Error$), 0 + 16,"システムエラー"
	Exit Function
End Function

Agents.Logic:
Agent: agtDelDoc
Source: Sub Initialize
	Dim ss 		As NotesSession
	Dim dbCurrent 	As NotesDatabase
	Dim agCurrent	As NotesAgent
	Dim docLog 	As NotesDocument
	Dim varStartTime	As Variant
	Dim strErrMsg		As String
	Dim varServer		As Variant
	Dim strAgentName	As String
	Dim strLogMsg		As String
	Dim strFormula		As String
	On Error Goto ERROR_HANDLE
	Set ss			 = New NotesSession
	Set dbCurrent	 = ss.CurrentDatabase
	Set agCurrent	 = ss.CurrentAgent
	varServer		= Evaluate("@Name([ABBREVIATE];@ServerName)")
	strAgentName 	= agCurrent.Name
	varStartTime 	 = Now
	Set docLog		 = dbCurrent.CreateDocument
	docLog.Form	 = "frmLogDoc"
	Call funcStartExecLog(docLog, varServer(0), strAgentName, "D01A　回答確認済文書アーカイブ処理")
	strFormula = { Form = "frmImusyokai" & StatusCode = "7000" & KakuninDate =< @Adjust(@Today; -5; 0; 0; 0; 0; 0) }
	Call subDeleteDoc(docLog, dbCurrent, strFormula)
	Call docLog.Save(True, True)
	varStartTime 	 = Now
	Set docLog		 = dbCurrent.CreateDocument
	docLog.Form	 = "frmLogDoc"
	Call funcStartExecLog(docLog, varServer(0), strAgentName, "D01B　起案中文書アーカイブ処理")
	strFormula = { Form = "frmImusyokai" & StatusCode = "1000" & EditDate =< @Adjust(@Today; 0; -1; 0; 0; 0; 0) }
	Call subDeleteDoc(docLog, dbCurrent, strFormula)
	Call docLog.Save(True, True)
	varStartTime 	 = Now
	Set docLog		 = dbCurrent.CreateDocument
	docLog.Form	= "frmLogDoc"
	Call funcStartExecLog(docLog, varServer(0), strAgentName, "D01C　削除ログ文書アーカイブ処理")
	strFormula = { (Form = "frmImusyokai"| Form = "frmSelectionMente" | Form = "frmSyukuCalendar") & DelFlag = 1 & DelDate =< @Adjust(@Today; 0; -1; 0; 0; 0; 0) }
	Call subDeleteDoc(docLog, dbCurrent, strFormula)
	Call docLog.Save(True, True)
	varStartTime 	 = Now
	Set docLog		 = dbCurrent.CreateDocument
	docLog.Form	 = "frmLogDoc"
	Call funcStartExecLog(docLog, varServer(0), strAgentName, "D01D　エージェントログ文書アーカイブ処理")
	strFormula = { Form = "frmLogDoc" & ExecStartDate =< @Adjust(@Today; -2; 0; 0; 0; 0; 0) }
	Call subDeleteDoc(docLog, dbCurrent, strFormula)
	Call docLog.Save(True, True)
	Exit Sub
ERROR_HANDLE:
	Call funcPutExecLog(docLog, 2, funcOnErrorMsg( "Initialize", Err, Erl, Error$ ) )
	Exit Sub
End Sub
Sub subDeleteDoc(docLog As NotesDocument, dbTarget As NotesDatabase, strFormula As String)
	Dim dcDelTarget As NotesDocumentCollection
	Dim strExecLog	As String
	Dim strErrMsg		As String
	Dim lngDocCount	As Long
	On Error Goto ERROR_HANDLE
	Call funcPutExecLog(docLog, 0, "削除処理開始" )
	Set dcDelTarget = dbTarget.Search(strFormula, Nothing, 0)
	lngDocCount = dcDelTarget.Count
	Call funcPutExecLog(docLog, 0, "削除対象文書　：　" & Cstr(lngDocCount) & "件" )
	If (lngDocCount = 0 ) Then
		Call funcPutExecLog(docLog, 0, "削除対象文書はありませんでした。" )
	Else
		Call dcDelTarget.RemoveAll(True)
	End If
	Call funcPutExecLog(docLog, 0, "削除処理完了" )
	Exit Sub
ERROR_HANDLE:
	strErrMsg = funcOnErrorMsg( "subDeleteDoc", Err, Erl, Error$ )
	Call funcPutExecLog(docLog, 2, strErrMsg )
	Exit Sub
End Sub

Agents.Name: D02.依頼日超過フラグセット処理
Agents.Logic:
Agent: agSetFlag
Source: Sub Initialize
	On Error Goto ErrTrap
	Dim ss				As NotesSession
	Dim db				As NotesDatabase
	Dim dc				As NotesDocumentCollection
	Dim doc			As NotesDocument
	Dim agFlag			As NotesAgent
	Dim varStartTime	As Variant
	Dim strFormula		As String
	Dim strEigyoDay	As String
	Dim intStatus		As Integer
	Dim intCount		As Integer
	Dim docLog		As NotesDocument
	Dim strAgName	As String
	Dim varServer		As Variant
	Dim strExecAction As String
	varStartTime 		= Now
	Set ss 				= New NotesSession
	Set agFlag 			= ss.CurrentAgent
	strAgName 		= agFlag.Name
	Set db 				= ss.CurrentDatabase
	varServer			= Evaluate("@Name([ABBREVIATE];@ServerName)")
	strExecAction 		= ("D02A　依頼日超過フラグセット処理")
	If db.IsOpen = False Then
		Print("D02.依頼日超過フラグセット処理-データベースが開かれていません。")
		Exit Sub
	End If
	Set docLog 		= db.CreateDocument
	docLog.Form 		= "frmLogDoc"
	Call funcStartExecLog( docLog, varServer(0), strAgName, strExecAction)
	Call funcPutExecLog( docLog, 0, "フラグセット処理開始")
	strEigyoDay = funcEigyobiGet(Format$(Today, "YYYY/MM/DD"), -5)
	strFormula 	= { (Form = "frmImusyokai") & (DelFlag = 0) & (IraiDate != "") & (IraiDate =< @TextToTime("} & strEigyoDay & {"))}
	Set dc = db.Search( strFormula$, Nothing, 0 )
	If dc.Count <= 0 Then
		Call funcPutExecLog( docLog, 0, "対象文書がありませんでした。")
		Call docLog.Save(False, False)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	intCount = 0
	Set doc = dc.GetFirstDocument
	Do Until doc Is Nothing
		intStatus = Cint(doc.StatusCode(0))
		If (doc.IraiOverFlag(0) = 1) Or ( intStatus < 3000 ) Or ( 5000 < intStatus ) Then
		Else
			doc.IraiOverFlag = 1
			intCount = intCount + 1
			Call doc.Save( False, False )
		End If
		Set doc = dc.GetNextDocument( doc )
	Loop
	Call funcPutExecLog( docLog, 0, Cstr( intCount ) & "件の処理が終了しました。")
	Call docLog.Save( False, False )
	Exit Sub
ErrTrap:
	Call funcPutExecLog( docLog, 2, funcOnErrorMsg("funcPutExecLog", Err, Erl, Error$))
	Call docLog.Save( False, False )
	Exit Sub
End Sub
Dependencies: libCommon
Validation: Use structured error handler
Error Handling: On Error Goto ErrTrap

Agents.Name: D03.競合文書削除処理
Agents.Logic:
Agent: agtDelConflict
Source: Sub Initialize
	On Error Goto ERR_HANDLE
	Dim ss As NotesSession
	Dim dbCur As NotesDatabase
	Dim agFlag As NotesAgent
	Dim viwConflict As NotesView
	Dim dcConflict As NotesDocumentCollection
	Dim docConflict As NotesDocument
	Dim itmDelDate As NotesItem
	Dim dtmTime As NotesDateTime
	Dim docLog As NotesDocument
	Dim strAgName As String
	Dim varServer As Variant
	varServer = Evaluate("@Name([ABBREVIATE];@ServerName)")
	Set ss = New  NotesSession
	Set dbCur = ss.CurrentDatabase
	Set agFlag = ss.CurrentAgent
	strAgName = agFlag.Name
	Set docLog = dbCur.CreateDocument
	docLog.Form = "frmLogDoc"
	Call funcStartExecLog( docLog, varServer(0), strAgName, "D03A 競合文書削除処理")
	Call funcPutExecLog( docLog, 0, "競合文書削除処理開始")
	Call funcPutExecLog( docLog, 0, "対象データ確認開始")
	Set dcConflict = dbCur.UnprocessedDocuments
	If dcConflict.Count = 0 Then
		Call funcPutExecLog( docLog, 0, "対象データなし")
		Call funcPutExecLog( docLog, 0, "競合文書削除処理終了")
		Exit Sub
	Else
		Call funcPutExecLog( docLog, 0, "対象データ数：" & Cstr(dcConflict.Count) & "件")
	End If
	Set dtmTime = New NotesDateTime( "" )
	Call dtmTime.SetNow
	Call funcPutExecLog( docLog, 0, "削除日付設定開始")
	Set docConflict = dcConflict.GetFirstDocument
	Do While Not docConflict Is Nothing
		Set itmDelDate = docConflict.GetFirstItem("DelDate")
		If itmDelDate Is Nothing Then
			Set itmDelDate = New NotesItem( docConflict, "DelDate", dtmTime )
		Else
			Set itmDelDate.DateTimeValue = dtmTime
		End If
		docConflict.DelFlag = 1
		Call docConflict.Save(True, False)
		Set itmDelDate = Nothing
		Set docConflict = dcConflict.GetNextDocument( docConflict )
	Loop
	Call funcPutExecLog( docLog, 0, "削除日付設定終了")
	Call funcPutExecLog( docLog, 0, "削除日付設定処理結果確認")
	Set viwConflict = dbCur.GetView("viwConflict")
	Set docConflict = viwConflict.GetFirstDocument
	If docConflict Is Nothing Then
		Call funcPutExecLog( docLog, 0, "正常終了確認")
	Else
		Call funcPutExecLog( docLog, 1, "処理残文書あり")
	End If
	Call funcPutExecLog( docLog, 0, "競合文書削除処理終了")
	Exit Sub
ERR_HANDLE:
	Call funcPutExecLog(docLog, 2, funcOnErrorMsg( "Initialize", Err, Erl, Error$ ) )
	Exit Sub
End Sub
Dependencies: libCommon
Validation: Use structured error handler
Error Handling: On Error Goto ERR_HANDLE

Agents.Name: ItemViewer
Agents.Logic:
Agent: ItemViewer
Source: Const TOOLNAME = "ItemViewer"
Const MAX_LEN = 50
Sub Initialize
	Dim ws 			As New NotesUIWorkspace
	Dim ss 			As New NotesSession
	Dim dbCurrent 		As NotesDatabase
	Dim dcTarget 		As NotesDocumentCollection
	Dim docTarget 		As NotesDocument
	Dim strName 		As String
	Dim strAttr 		As String
	Dim strText 		As String
	Dim strItemList() 	As String
	Dim strList			As String
	Dim varSortList	As Variant
	Dim varRes		As Variant
	Dim intNameLen	As Integer
	Dim intAttrLen		As Integer
	Dim intIndex 		As Integer
	Dim strSpace1		As String
	Dim strSpace2		As String
	Dim objStream 		As NotesStream
	Dim strFile 		As String
	Dim i 				As Integer
	Redim strItemList(0)
	Set dbCurrent = ss.CurrentDatabase
	If Not dbCurrent.CurrentAccessLevel = ACLLEVEL_MANAGER Then
		Msgbox "管理者以外は使用できません。" , 16 , TOOLNAME
		Exit Sub
	End If
	Set dcTarget = dbCurrent.UnprocessedDocuments
	If dcTarget.Count <> 1 Then
		Msgbox "1文書のみ選択してください。", 48, TOOLNAME
		Exit Sub
	End If
	Set docTarget = dcTarget.GetFirstDocument
	intIndex = 0
	Forall itmTarget In docTarget.Items
		With itmTarget
			strName = .Name
			strText = .Text
			strText = Replace(strText, {\}, {\\})
			strText = Replace(strText, {"}, {\"})
			If Len(strText) > MAX_LEN Then
				strText = Left$(strText, MAX_LEN) & "..."
			End If
			Select Case .Type
			Case ACTIONCD
				strAttr = "[ACTIONCD]"
			Case ASSISTANTINFO
				strAttr = "[ASSISTANTINFO]"
			Case ATTACHMENT
				strAttr = "[ATTACHMENT]"
			Case AUTHORS
				strAttr = "[AUTHORS]"
			Case COLLATION
				strAttr = "[COLLATION]"
			Case DATETIMES
				strAttr = "[DATETIMES]"
			Case EMBEDDEDOBJECT
				strAttr = "[EMBEDDEDOBJECT]"
			Case ERRORITEM
				strAttr = "[ERRORITEM]"
			Case FORMULA
				strAttr = "[FORMULA]"
			Case HTML
				strAttr = "[HTML]"
			Case ICON
				strAttr = "[ICON]"
			Case LSOBJECT
				strAttr = "[LSOBJECT]"
			Case MIME_PART
				strAttr = "[MIME_PART]"
			Case NAMES
				strAttr = "[NAMES]"
			Case NOTELINKS
				strAttr = "[NOTELINKS]"
			Case NOTEREFS
				strAttr = "[NOTEREFS]"
			Case NUMBERS
				strAttr = "[NUMBERS]"
			Case OTHEROBJECT
				strAttr = "[OTHEROBJECT]"
			Case QUERYCD
				strAttr = "[QUERYCD]"
			Case READERS
				strAttr = "[READERS]"
			Case RICHTEXT
				strAttr = "[RICHTEXT]"
			Case SIGNATURE
				strAttr = "[SIGNATURE]"
			Case TEXT
				strAttr = "[TEXT]"
			Case UNAVAILABLE
				strAttr = "[UNAVAILABLE]"
			Case UNKNOWN
				strAttr = "[UNKNOWN]"
			Case USERDATA
				strAttr = "[USERDATA]"
			Case USERID
				strAttr = "[USERID]"
			Case VIEWMAPDATA
				strAttr = "[VIEWMAPDATA]"
			Case VIEWMAPLAYOUT
				strAttr = "[VIEWMAPLAYOUT]"
			End Select
		End With
		Redim Preserve strItemList(intIndex)
		intNameLen = Lenbp(strName)
		If intNameLen >= 25 Then
			strSpace1 = " "
		Else
			strSpace1 = Space(26 - intNameLen)
		End If
		intAttrLen = Lenbp(strAttr)
		If intAttrLen >= 20 Then
			strSpace2 = " "
		Else
			strSpace2 = Space(21 - intAttrLen)
		End If
		strItemList(intIndex) = {"} & strName  & strSpace1 & strAttr & strSpace2 & {\"} & strText & {\"} & {"}
		intIndex = intIndex + 1
	End Forall
	strList = Join(strItemList, ":")
	varSortList = Evaluate("@Sort(" & strList & ")")
	varRes = ws.Prompt(PROMPT_OKCANCELLIST, TOOLNAME, _
	"選択された文書のアイテム一覧をファイルに書き出しますか？" & Chr(10) & _
	"★ OK           … ファイル書き出し" & Chr(10) & _
	"☆ キャンセル … 処理終了", varSortList(0), varSortList)
	If Isempty(varRes) = True Then
		Exit Sub
	End If
	varRes = ws.SaveFileDialog(False)
	If Isempty(varRes) Then
		Msgbox "処理を中止しました。", 64, TOOLNAME
		Exit Sub
	End If
	strFile = varRes(0)
	If Dir$(strFile) <> "" Then
		varRes = Msgbox("以下のファイルは既に存在します。上書きしますか？" _
		& Chr(13) & Chr(10) & strFile, 32+4+256, TOOLNAME)
		If varRes <> 6 Then
			Msgbox "処理を中止しました。", 64, TOOLNAME
			Exit Sub
		End If
	End If
	Set objStream = ss.CreateStream
	Call objStream.Open(strFile)
	If objStream.IsReadOnly =True Then
		Msgbox "指定されたファイルは読み取り専用のため、処理を中止しました。", 64, TOOLNAME
		Call objStream.Close
		Exit Sub
	Else
		Call objStream.Truncate
	End If
	For i = 0 To Ubound(varSortList)
		Call objStream.WriteText(varSortList(i), EOL_PLATFORM)
	Next i
	Call objStream.Close
	Exit Sub
ERR_HANDLE:
	Msgbox "以下のエラーが発生しました。管理者に連絡してください。" & Chr(13) & Chr(10) & _
	"【識別名】 " & "ItemViewer.Initialize" & Chr(13) & Chr(10) & _
	"【エラー番号】 " & Err & Chr(13) & Chr(10) & _
	"【エラーメッセージ】 " & Error$ & Chr(13) & Chr(10) & _
	"【エラー発生行】 " & Erl, 16, TOOLNAME
	If (objStream Is Nothing) = False Then
		Call objStream.Close
	End If
	Exit Sub
End Sub

	Private m_ss As NotesSession

Public Class clsDocElement
	Private m_doc As NotesDocument
	Private m_rtItem As Variant
	Private m_listFName As Variant
	Private m_lngProperty As Long
	Public Sub new( doc As NotesDocument )
		Set m_doc = doc
	End Sub
	Public Sub delete
		Set m_listFName = Nothing
		Set m_rtItem = Nothing
		Set m_doc = Nothing
	End Sub
	Public Sub GetFList()
		On Error Goto ERR_HANDLE
		Dim vItemList As Variant
		Dim vFNameList As Variant
		Dim strAllFName As String
		vItemList = m_doc.Items
		Forall tmpItem In vItemList
			If strAllFName = "" Then
				strAllFName = {"} & tmpItem.Name & {"}
			Else
				strAllFName = strAllFName & ":" & {"} & tmpItem.Name & {"}
			End If
		End Forall
		vFNameList = Evaluate( {@Sort(} & strAllFName & {)} )
		If Isarray(vFNameList) = False Then
			m_listFName = Split("")
		Else
			m_listFName = vFNameList
		End If
		Exit Sub
ERR_HANDLE:
		m_listFName = Split("")
		Exit Sub
	End Sub
	Public Sub GetFInfo ( strFName As String, intType As Integer )
		If intType = 0 Then
			Set m_rtItem = m_doc.GetFirstItem( strFName )
		Elseif inttype = 1 Then
			m_lngProperty = m_rtItem.Type
		Else
		End If
	End Sub
	Property Get ListFName As Variant
		listFName = m_listFName
	End Property
	Property Get FValue As Variant
		Set FValue = m_rtItem
	End Property
	Property Get FProperty As Long
		FProperty = m_lngProperty
	End Property
	Property Get AttachList As Variant
		Dim eb As Variant
		Dim strFileName As String
		eb = m_rtItem.EmbeddedObjects
		If Isarray( eb ) = True Then
			Forall tmpFile In eb
				If strFileName = "" Then
					strFileName = tmpFile.Source
				Else
					strFileName = strFileName & ";" & tmpFile.Source
				End If
			End Forall
		End If
		Set eb = Nothing
		AttachList = Split( strFileName, ";" )
	End Property
End Class

		End Select

				Select Case intType

	Public Function ChangeValue( docTarget As NotesDocument ) As Integer
		On Error Goto ERR_HANDLE
		Dim varExistItem As Variant
		Dim varResult As Variant
		Dim varFNameList As Variant
		Dim strSetType As String
		Dim blnIsNames As Boolean
		Dim blnIsReaders As Boolean
		Dim blnIsAuthors As Boolean
		ChangeValue = -1
		varFNameList = Split( Me.FName, ";" )
		Forall tmpFName In varFNameList
			Set varExistItem = docTarget.GetFirstItem( tmpFName )
			Select Case Me.SetTypeInfo
			Case "E"
				If varExistItem Is Nothing Then
				Else
					Select Case varExistItem.Type
					Case 1
						Call Me.DeleteAttachFile( varExistItem )
					Case Else
					End Select
					Call varExistItem.Remove
				End If
			Case "U"
				With varExistItem
					blnIsNames =  .IsNames
					blnIsReaders =  .IsReaders
					blnIsAuthors =  .IsAuthors
				End With
				varResult = Split(Me.SetChangeInfo, ";", -1, 5)
				Set varExistItem = docTarget.ReplaceItemValue( tmpFName, Replace( varExistItem.Values, varResult(0), varResult(1) ) )
				With varExistItem
					.IsNames = blnIsNames
					.IsReaders = blnIsReaders
					.IsAuthors = blnIsAuthors
				End With
				Erase varResult
			Case "C"
				With varExistItem
					If Instr(Me.SetChangeInfo, "N") > 0 Then
						.IsNames = True
					Else
						.IsNames = False
					End If
					If Instr(Me.SetChangeInfo, "R") > 0 Then
						.IsReaders = True
					Else
						.IsReaders = False
					End If
					If Instr(Me.SetChangeInfo, "A") > 0 Then
						.IsAuthors = True
					Else
						.IsAuthors = False
					End If
				End With
			Case Else
				If varExistItem Is Nothing Then
				Else
					Select Case varExistItem.type
					Case 1
						Call Me.DeleteAttachFile( varExistItem )
					Case Else
					End Select
					Call varExistItem.Remove
				End If
				Set varExistItem = Me.CustomData.CopyItemToDocument( docTarget, tmpFName )
				Select Case varExistItem.type
				Case 1
					Call varExistItem.Compact
				Case Else
				End Select
			End Select
		End Forall
		ChangeValue = 0
		Exit Function
ERR_HANDLE:
		ChangeValue = -1
		Exit Function
	End Function
	Public Sub AddValue( docTarget As NotesDocument )
		Dim varResultSet As Variant
		Dim varResult As Variant
		Dim varExistItem As Variant
		Dim blnIsNames As Boolean
		Dim blnIsReaders As Boolean
		Dim blnIsAuthors As Boolean
		Set varExistItem = docTarget.GetFirstItem( Me.FName )
		Select Case varExistItem.type
		Case 1
			Call varExistItem.AppendRTItem( Me.CustomData )
			Call varExistItem.Compact
		Case Else
			If Ubound(Me.CustomData.Values) > 0 Then
				Call varExistItem.AppendToTextList( Me.CustomData.Values )
			Else
				Redim varResultSet(0)
				Forall strTag In varExistItem.Values
					If varResultSet(0) = "" Then
						varResultSet(0) = strTag & Me.CustomData.text
					Else
						varResultSet = Arrayappend(varResultSet, strTag & Me.CustomData.text)
					End If
				End Forall
				With varExistItem
					blnIsNames =  .IsNames
					blnIsReaders =  .IsReaders
					blnIsAuthors =  .IsAuthors
				End With
				Set varExistItem = docTarget.ReplaceItemValue( Me.FName, varResultSet )
				With varExistItem
					.IsNames = blnIsNames
					.IsReaders = blnIsReaders
					.IsAuthors = blnIsAuthors
				End With
				Erase varResultSet
			End If
		End Select
	End Sub

	Public Sub SetFormat( docTarget As NotesDocument, lngLoop As Long )
		Dim varFNameList As Variant
		Dim varExistItem As Variant
		Dim varItem As Variant
		Dim strPiece As String
		Dim strReplace As String
		Dim strCustomize As String
		Dim strData As String
		Dim intCnt As Integer
		varFNameList = Split( Me.FName, ";" )
		Forall tmpFName In varFNameList
			strCustomize = ""
			strReplace = ""
			Set varExistItem = docTarget.GetFirstItem( tmpFName )
			If varExistItem Is Nothing Then
			Else
				Select Case varExistItem.Type
				Case 1
					Call Me.DeleteAttachFile( varExistItem )
				Case Else
				End Select
				Call varExistItem.Remove
			End If
			If Me.setChangeInfo = "%" Then
				Call docTarget.ReplaceItemValue( tmpFName, lngLoop )
			Else
				For intCnt = 1 To Len( Me.SetChangeInfo )
					strPiece = Mid( Me.SetChangeInfo, intCnt, 1 )
					strReplace = strReplace & strPiece
					If Left( strReplace, 1 ) = "[" Then
						If strPiece = "]" Then
							If strReplace = "[%]" Then
								strCustomize = strCustomize & Cstr(lngLoop)
							Elseif strReplace = "[" & Ustring(Len(strReplace)-2, "*") & "]" Then
								strCustomize = strCustomize & Right( Ustring(Len(strReplace)-2, "0") & Cstr( lngLoop ), Len( strReplace)-2 )
							Else
								Set varItem = docTarget.GetFirstItem( Mid( strReplace, 2, Len(strReplace)-2 ) )
								If varItem Is Nothing Then
									strData = ""
								Else
									If varItem.Type = 1 Then
										strData = varItem.UnformattedText( )
									Else
										strData = varItem.Text
									End If
								End If
								strCustomize = strCustomize & strData
								strData = ""
							End If
							strReplace = ""
						Else
						End If
					Else
						strCustomize = strCustomize & strReplace
						strReplace = ""
					End If
				Next
				strCustomize = strCustomize & strReplace
				Call docTarget.ReplaceItemValue( tmpFName, strCustomize )
			End If
		End Forall
	End Sub
	Public Function fncDocCopyDel( intType As Integer, docTarget As NotesDocument ) As Integer
		Dim docCopy As NotesDocument
		fncDocCopyDel = -1
		Select Case intType
		Case 1,3
			Set docCopy = docTarget.CopyToDatabase( m_dbCopy )
			If ( docCopy.IsDeleted = False ) Then
			Else
				fncDocCopyDel = 1
				Exit Function
			End If
		Case Else
		End Select
		Select Case intType
		Case 2,3
			If ( docTarget.IsDeleted = False ) Then
				If ( docTarget.Remove( False ) = False ) Then
					fncDocCopyDel = 2
					Exit Function
				Else
				End If
			Else
				fncDocCopyDel = 3
				Exit Function
			End If
		Case Else
		End Select
		fncDocCopyDel = 0
	End Function

	Public Sub AllDocCopyDel( intType As Integer, dcTarget As NotesDocumentCollection )
		Dim exporter As NotesDXLExporter
		Dim importer As NotesDXLImporter
		Select Case intType
		Case 1,3
			Set exporter = m_ss.CreateDXLExporter
			Call exporter.SetInput(dcTarget)
			Set importer = m_ss.CreateDXLImporter
			Call importer.SetInput(exporter)
			Call importer.SetOutput(m_dbCopy)
			Call exporter.Process
		Case Else
		End Select
		Select Case intType
		Case 2,3
			Call dcTarget.RemoveAll( True )
		Case Else
		End Select

Sub Initialize
	On Error Goto ERR_HANDLE
	Dim objBaseDBInfo As clsBaseDBInfo
	Dim objDocElement As clsDocElement
	Dim objInputInfo As clsInputInfo
	Dim strSearchMacro As String
	Dim intReturn As Integer
	Dim blnSelectFlg As Boolean
	Dim blnLoopFlg As Boolean
	Do
		blnSelectFlg = False
		intReturn = fncDataPreparation( strSearchMacro, _
		objBaseDBInfo, objDocElement, objInputInfo )
		Select Case intReturn
		Case 0
			strSearchMacro = ""
		Case Else
			Exit Sub
		End Select
		Do
			blnLoopFlg = False
			intReturn = fncMain( objBaseDBInfo, objDocElement, objInputInfo )
			Select Case intReturn
			Case 0
				blnLoopFlg = objInputInfo.RepetitionFlg
			Case 1
				If objInputInfo.RepetitionFlg = False Then
					Exit Sub
				Elseif Msgbox( "連続入力を終了しますか？", 4+32+256, "連続入力確認" ) = 7 Then
					blnLoopFlg = True
				Else
					Exit Sub
				End If
			Case 2
				blnSelectFlg = True
				strSearchMacro = objInputInfo.InputValue
			Case 4
				blnLoopFlg = True
			Case Else
				Exit Sub
			End Select
			Call objInputInfo.InitialSet( )
		Loop While blnLoopFlg = True
	Loop While blnSelectFlg = True
	Exit Sub
ERR_HANDLE:
	Call OnErrorMsgDisp( "Initializeイベント", Erl, Err, Error$ )
	Exit Sub
End Sub
Function fncDataPreparation( strSearchMacro As String, _
objBaseDBInfo As clsBaseDBInfo, objDocElement As clsDocElement, _
objInputInfo As clsInputInfo ) As Integer
	On Error Goto ERR_HANDLE
	fncDataPreparation = -1
	Dim strTitle As String
	Dim strMsg As String
	Dim intReturn As Integer
	Dim lngSelectCnt As Long
	If objBaseDBInfo Is Nothing Then
		Set objBaseDBInfo = New clsBaseDBInfo
		Select Case objBaseDBInfo.ACLLevel
		Case ACLLEVEL_MANAGER
		Case ACLLEVEL_EDITOR , ACLLEVEL_DESIGNER
			If  Isnull(Arraygetindex(objBaseDBInfo.UserRoles, "[DATACHANGE]", 1) ) = False Then
			Else
				Msgbox "使用する権限がありません。" , 16 , "使用不可"
				fncDataPreparation = 1
				Exit Function
			End If
		Case Else
			Msgbox "使用する権限がありません。" , 16 , "使用不可"
			fncDataPreparation = 1
			Exit Function
		End Select
	End If
	With objBaseDBInfo
		Call  .GetSelectDoc( strSearchMacro )
		lngSelectCnt =  .SelectDocCnt
	End With
	If strSearchMacro = "" Then
		Select Case lngSelectCnt
		Case 0
			Msgbox "文書を選択してから実行してください。" , 48 , "対象文書未選択"
			fncDataPreparation = 1
			Exit Function
		Case 1
		Case Else
			If Msgbox( "現在、" & Cstr( lngSelectCnt ) & "件の文書を選択しています･･･" & Chr(13)_
			& "処理を続行してもよろしいですか？", 4+32, "変更件数確認" ) = 7 Then
				Msgbox "データ変更を取りやめました。" , 48 , "変更中止"
				fncDataPreparation = 1
				Exit Function
			End If
		End Select
	Else
		Select Case lngSelectCnt
		Case 0
			Call objBaseDBInfo.GetSelectDoc( "" )
			lngSelectCnt = objBaseDBInfo.SelectDocCnt
			Msgbox "条件に該当する文書が見つかりませんでした。" & Chr(13) _
			& "代わりに選択文書" & Cstr( lngSelectCnt ) & "件を処理対象にします。" , 48 , "対象文書なし"
		Case Else
			Msgbox Cstr( lngSelectCnt ) & "件の文書が見つかりました。" & Chr(13) _
			& "抽出した文書を処理対象にします。" , 64 , "対象文書抽出"
		End Select
	End If
	Call objBaseDBInfo.GetFirstDoc( )
	If objDocElement Is Nothing Then
	Else
		Delete objDocElement
	End If
	Set objDocElement = New clsDocElement( objBaseDBInfo.FirstDoc )
	Call objDocElement.GetFList( )
	If objInputInfo Is Nothing Then
		Set objInputInfo = New clsInputInfo
	Else
	End If
	strTitle = "変更フィールド指定≪選択文書数" & Cstr( lngSelectCnt ) & "件≫"
	strMsg = {データ変更を行うフィールド名を入力してください。} & Chr(13) _
	& {また、特殊操作のヘルプを参照する場合は「?」を入力してください。}
	Call objInputInfo.FNameInfo( strTitle, strMsg, "", objDocElement.listFName )
	fncDataPreparation = 0
	Exit Function
ERR_HANDLE:
	Call OnErrorMsgDisp( "fncDataPreparation関数", Erl, Err, Error$ )
	fncDataPreparation = -1
	Exit Function
End Function
Function fncMain( objBaseDBInfo As clsBaseDBInfo, objDocElement As clsDocElement, _
objInputInfo As clsInputInfo ) As Integer
	On Error Goto ERR_HANDLE
	fncMain = -1
	Dim objDataSetPreparation As clsDataSetPreparation
	Dim intReturn As Integer
	intReturn = fncSelectAct( objInputInfo )
	Select Case intReturn
	Case 0
	Case 1
		fncMain = 1
		Exit Function
	Case Else
		fncMain = -1
		Exit Function
	End Select
	intReturn = fncExistDataDecision( objDocElement, objInputInfo )
	Select Case intReturn
	Case 0
	Case 1
		fncMain = 1
		Exit Function
	Case 2
		fncMain = 4
		Exit Function
	Case Else
		fncMain = -1
		Exit Function
	End Select
	intReturn = fncDataTypeSelect( objInputInfo )
	Select Case intReturn
	Case 0
	Case 1
		fncMain = 1
		Exit Function
	Case Else
		fncMain = -1
		Exit Function
	End Select
	intReturn = fncSetDataInput( objInputInfo, objDataSetPreparation )
	Select Case intReturn
	Case 0
	Case 1
		fncMain = 1
		Exit Function
	Case 2
		fncMain = 2
		Exit Function
	Case Else
		fncMain = -1
		Exit Function
	End Select
	intReturn = fncInputDataReplace( objDataSetPreparation, objBaseDBInfo )
	Select Case intReturn
	Case 0
	Case 1
		fncMain = 3
		Exit Function
	Case Else
		fncMain = -1
		Exit Function
	End Select
	fncMain = 0
	Exit Function
ERR_HANDLE:
	Call OnErrorMsgDisp( "fncMain関数", Erl, Err, Error$ )
	fncMain = -1
	Exit Function
End Function
Function fncSelectAct( objInputInfo As clsInputInfo ) As Integer
	On Error Goto ERR_HANDLE
	Dim strFName As String
	Dim intReturn As Integer
	Dim blnInputFlg As Boolean
	fncSelectAct = -1
	Do
		blnInputFlg = False
		intReturn = objInputInfo.fncPromptSet( 1 )
		If intReturn < 1 Then
			Msgbox "データ変更を取りやめました。" , 48 , "変更中止"
			fncSelectAct = 1
			Exit Function
		Else
			strFName = Strconv( objInputInfo.FName, 8 )
		End If
		Select Case strFName
		Case "&"
			objInputInfo.RepetitionFlg = True
			blnInputFlg = True
			Msgbox "連続入力可能に設定しました。", 64, "連続入力"
		Case "%"
			objInputInfo.LogFlg = True
			blnInputFlg = True
			Msgbox "ログ書出し設定にしました。", 64, "ログ設定"
		Case "/"
			objInputInfo.AllSetFlg = True
			blnInputFlg = True
			Msgbox "一括処理可能に設定しました。", 64, "一括処理設定"
		Case "@"
			If objInputInfo.AllSetFlg = True Then
				blnInputFlg = True
				Msgbox "一括処理を設定した場合、" & Chr(13)_
				& "式の実行はできません。", 48, "INPUT ERROR"
			Else
			End If
		Case "!A"
			If Msgbox( "文書を増殖します。" & Chr(13) & "よろしいですか？", 4+32+256, "入力確認" ) = 7 Then
				blnInputFlg = True
				Msgbox "再度入力してください。", 64, "入力確認"
			Else
			End If
		Case "!C"
			If Msgbox( "文書をコピーします。" & Chr(13) & "よろしいですか？", 4+32+256, "入力確認" ) = 7 Then
				blnInputFlg = True
				Msgbox "再度入力してください。", 64, "入力確認"
			Else
			End If
		Case "!D"
			If Msgbox( "文書を削除します。" & Chr(13) & "よろしいですか？", 4+32+256, "入力確認" ) = 7 Then
				blnInputFlg = True
				Msgbox "再度入力してください。", 64, "入力確認"
			Else
			End If
		Case "!M"
			If Msgbox( "文書を移動します。" & Chr(13) & "よろしいですか？", 4+32+256, "入力確認" ) = 7 Then
				blnInputFlg = True
				Msgbox "再度入力してください。", 64, "入力確認"
			Else
			End If
		Case "!R"
			If objInputInfo.AllSetFlg = True Then
				blnInputFlg = True
				Msgbox "一括処理を設定した場合、" & Chr(13)_
				& "文書の更新はできません。", 48, "INPUT ERROR"
			Elseif Msgbox( "文書を更新します。" & Chr(13) & "よろしいですか？", 4+32+256, "入力確認" ) = 7 Then
				blnInputFlg = True
				Msgbox "再度入力してください。", 64, "入力確認"
			Else
			End If
		Case "?"
			blnInputFlg = True
			Msgbox SelectReturnString("FIELDNAME_HELP_MESSAGE"), 64, "特殊操作ヘルプ"
		Case Else
			If Left( strFName, 1 ) = ";" Then
				blnInputFlg = True
				Msgbox "はじめにセミコロンは入力できません。", 48, "INPUT ERROR"
			Elseif Right( strFName, 1 ) = ";" Then
				blnInputFlg = True
				Msgbox "最後にセミコロンは入力できません。", 48, "INPUT ERROR"
			Elseif Instr( 1, strFName, ";;", 0 ) > 0 Then
				blnInputFlg = True
				Msgbox "連続したセミコロンは入力できません。", 48, "INPUT ERROR"
			Elseif ( objInputInfo.AllSetFlg = True ) And ( Instr( 1, strFName, ";", 0 ) > 0 ) Then
				blnInputFlg = True
				Msgbox "一括処理を設定した場合、" & Chr(13)_
				& "複数フィールドに対して処理できません。", 48, "INPUT ERROR"
			Else
			End If
		End Select
	Loop While blnInputFlg = True
	fncSelectAct = 0
	Exit Function
ERR_HANDLE:
	Call OnErrorMsgDisp( "fncSelectAct関数", Erl, Err, Error$ )
	fncSelectAct = -1
	Exit Function
End Function
Function fncExistDataDecision( objDocElement As clsDocElement, _
objInputInfo As clsInputInfo ) As Integer
	On Error Goto ERR_HANDLE
	fncExistDataDecision = -1
	Dim varSetDefault As Variant
	Dim varSetSubDefault As Variant
	Dim varSetTypeDefault As Variant
	Dim varFName As Variant
	Dim strFName As String
	Dim strTitle As String
	Dim strMsg As String
	Dim strData As String
	Dim strDefault As String
	Dim strSubDefault As String
	Dim strSelectMain As String
	Dim strTmp As String
	Dim strSubType As String
	Dim strType As String
	Dim strTypeElement As String
	strFName = Strconv(objInputInfo.FName, 8)
	Select Case strFName
	Case "@", "!A", "!C", "!D", "!M", "!R", "*"
		fncExistDataDecision = 0
		Exit Function
	Case Else
	End Select
	varFName = Split( objInputInfo.FName, ";" )
	If Ubound(varFName) > 0 Then
		Call MakeMsg(objDocElement, varFName)
		Call objInputInfo.SetOldProperty( "", "" )
		strTitle = "☆フィールド名：『" & objInputInfo.FName & "』"
		strMsg = SelectReturnString( "REPLACE_FIELD_MESSAGE" )
		strDefault = "S"
		strSelectMain = "S/D/N/V/R/E/S[N]/S[NR]/S[NA]/Z"
		strSubDefault =  "V-D"
	Else
		Call objDocElement.GetFInfo( objInputInfo.FName, 0 )
		If objDocElement.FValue Is Nothing Then
			Msgbox "フィールドが存在しません。" & Chr(13) & "データを新規作成します。" , 64 , "データ作成"
			strTitle = "☆フィールド名：『" & objInputInfo.FName & "』"
			strMsg = SelectReturnString( "NEW_FIELD_MESSAGE" )
			strDefault = "S"
			If objInputInfo.AllSetFlg = False Then
				strSelectMain = "S/D/N/V/R/S[N]/S[NR]/S[NA]/Z"
			Else
				strSelectMain = "S/D/N/V/Z"
			End If
			strSubDefault =  "V-D"
		Else
			With objDocElement
				Call  .GetFInfo( objInputInfo.FName, 1 )
				strDefault = fncExistType(  .FProperty,  .FValue )
			End With
			strType = fncSeparateProperty( strDefault, 0 )
			strTypeElement = fncSeparateProperty( strDefault, 1 )
			If objInputInfo.AllSetFlg = False Then
			Else
				Select Case strDefault
				Case "S", "D", "N", "V", "V-D"
				Case Else
					fncExistDataDecision = 2
					Msgbox SelectReturnString("ALLSET_ERROR_MESSAGE"), 48 , "一括処理不可"
					Exit Function
				End Select
			End If
			Select Case strType
			Case "R", "V-R"
				If objDocElement.AttachList( 0 ) <> "" Then
					Forall tmpFile In objDocElement.AttachList
						strTmp = strTmp & "       ⇒" & tmpFile & Chr(13)
					End Forall
					Msgbox "指定したフィールドに以下のファイルが保存されています。" & Chr(13)&Chr(13)_
					& strTmp & Chr(13) & SelectReturnString( "FILE_CHECK_MESSAGE" ), 64, "ファイルの確認"
				End If
			Case Else
			End Select
			If strType = "R" Then
				strData = objDocElement.FValue.GetUnFormattedText()
			Else
				strData = objDocElement.FValue.text
			End If
			Call objInputInfo.SetOldProperty( strDefault, strData )
			If Len(strData) > 50 Then
				strTmp = Left(strData, 50) & "･･･"
			Else
				strTmp = strData
			End If
			strTitle = "☆フィールド名：『" & objInputInfo.FName & "』    ★値：『" & strTmp & "』"
			strMsg = SelectReturnString("REPLACE_FIELD_MESSAGE")
			If objInputInfo.AllSetFlg = False Then
				strSelectMain = "S/D/N/V/R/E/S[N]/S[NR]/S[NA]"
				If strType = "S" Then
					strSelectMain = strSelectMain & "/U/A/C"
				Elseif strType = "R" Then
					strSelectMain = strSelectMain & "/A"
				Else
				End If
				strSelectMain = strSelectMain & "/Z/" & strDefault
				Select Case strType
				Case "S","D","N","V","R"
					strSubDefault =  "V-D"
				Case Else
					strSubDefault = strDefault
				End Select
			Else
				strSelectMain = "S/D/N/V/Z/" & strDefault
				strSubDefault =  "V-D"
			End If
		End If
	End If
	varSetDefault = KeywordListReturn( strDefault )
	Call objInputInfo.MainInfo( strTitle, strMsg, varSetDefault(0), KeywordListReturn( strSelectMain ) )
	strMsg = SelectReturnString("SPECIAL_ELEMENT_MESSAGE")
	If objInputInfo.AllSetFlg = False Then
		strSelectMain = "V-D/V-R/S[NRA]/V[NRA]/V[N]/V[NR]/V[NA]/F"
	Else
		strSelectMain = "V-D"
	End If
	varSetSubDefault = KeywordListReturn( strSubDefault )
	Call objInputInfo.SpecialInfo( strTitle, strMsg, varSetSubDefault(0), KeywordListReturn( strSelectMain ) )
	If strTypeElement <> "" Then
		varSetTypeDefault = KeywordListReturn("[" & strTypeElement & "]")
	Else
		varSetTypeDefault = KeywordListReturn("S")
	End If
	strTitle = "◆設定する型･･･【属性変更】  ☆フィールド名：『" & objInputInfo.FName & "』"
	strMsg = "設定する型を選択してください。"
	Call objInputInfo.ElementInfo( strTitle, strMsg, varSetTypeDefault(0), KeywordListReturn( "S/[N]/[NR]/[NA]/[NRA]" ) )
	fncExistDataDecision = 0
	Exit Function
ERR_HANDLE:
	Call OnErrorMsgDisp( "fncExistDataDecision関数", Erl, Err, Error$ )
	fncExistDataDecision = -1
	Exit Function
End Function
Function fncDataTypeSelect( objInputInfo As clsInputInfo ) As Integer
	On Error Goto ERR_HANDLE
	Dim varSelect As Variant
	Dim strType As String
	Dim strTypeElement As String
	Dim strTitle As String
	Dim strMsg As String
	Dim strData As String
	Dim strKata As String
	Dim intReturn As Integer
	Dim blnJudge As Boolean
	fncDataTypeSelect = -1
	strType = Strconv(objInputInfo.FName, 8)
	Select Case strType
	Case "@","!A","!C","!D","!M","!R","*"
		objInputInfo.FProperty = strType
		blnJudge = True
	Case Else
		blnJudge = False
	End Select
	Do While blnJudge = False
		blnJudge = True
		strType = ""
		strTypeElement = ""
		intReturn = objInputInfo.fncPromptSet(2)
		If intReturn < 1  Then
			fncDataTypeSelect = 1
			Msgbox "データ変更を取りやめました。" , 48 , "変更中止"
			Exit Function
		Else
			strType = fncSeparateProperty( objInputInfo.FProperty, 0 )
		End If
		Select Case strType
		Case "Z"
			intReturn = objInputInfo.fncPromptSet(3)
		Case "C"
			intReturn = objInputInfo.fncPromptSet(5)
		Case Else
		End Select
		If intReturn < 1  Then
			fncDataTypeSelect = 1
			Msgbox "データ変更を取りやめました。" , 48 , "変更中止"
			Exit Function
		Else
			With objInputInfo
				strType = fncSeparateProperty(  .FProperty, 0 )
				strTypeElement = fncSeparateProperty(  .FProperty, 1 )
			End With
		End If
		strKata = fncTypeReturn( strType, strTypeElement )
		Select Case strType
		Case "R","A"
			If ( strType = "R" ) Or _
			(( strType = "A" ) And ( fncSeparateProperty( objInputInfo.FOldProperty, 0 ) = "R" )) Then
				Msgbox SelectReturnString("RICHFIELD_HELP_MESSAGE"), 0, _
				"「Alt」+「Print Screen」でヘルプ画面を一時的に画像ファイルに表示してください。"
			Else
			End If
		Case "V","V-D","V-R"
			If Msgbox(strKata & "を設定します。" & Chr(13)_
			& "よろしいですか？", 4+32, "NULL設定確認" ) = 7 Then
				Msgbox "設定したい型を再度入力してください。" , 48 , "変更中止"
				blnJudge = False
			End If
		Case "E"
			If Msgbox("フィールドごと消去します。" & Chr(13)_
			& "よろしいですか？", 4+32, "フィールド消去確認" ) = 7 Then
				Msgbox "設定したい型を再度入力してください。" , 48 , "変更中止"
				blnJudge = False
			End If
		Case Else
		End Select
	Loop
	Select Case strType
	Case "S","N","D","R","A","F","U"
		strTitle = "◆設定する型･･･" & strKata & "  ☆フィールド名：『" & objInputInfo.FName & "』"
	Case "@"
		strTitle = "◆式実行"
	Case "!A"
		strTitle = "◆文書増殖"
	Case "!C"
		strTitle = "◆文書コピー"
	Case "!M"
		strTitle = "◆文書移動"
	Case "!R"
		strTitle = "◆文書更新"
	Case "*"
		strTitle = "◆文書抽出"
	Case Else
		strTitle = ""
	End Select
	Select Case strType
	Case "S","N","D"
		strMsg = SelectReturnString( "SET_NORMALFIELD_MESSAGE" )
		If fncSeparateProperty( objInputInfo.FProperty, 2 ) = "S" Then
			strMsg = strMsg & Chr(13) & SelectReturnString( "SET_STRINGFIELD_ADDMESSAGE" )
		End If
	Case "R"
		strMsg =  "フィールドに設定する値を入力してください。(キャンセルで中止)" & Chr(13)_
		& SelectReturnString( "SET_RICHFIELD_MESSAGE" )
	Case "U"
		strMsg = SelectReturnString( "SET_UPDATEFIELD_MESSAGE" )
	Case "A"
		strMsg = "フィールドに追加する値を入力してください。(キャンセルで中止)" & Chr(13)
		If fncSeparateProperty( objInputInfo.FOldProperty, 0 ) = "R" Then
			strMsg = strMsg & SelectReturnString( "SET_RICHFIELD_MESSAGE" )
		Else
			strMsg = strMsg & SelectReturnString( "SET_STRINGFIELD_ADDMESSAGE" ) & Chr(13)_
			& SelectReturnString( "SET_APPENDFIELD_MESSAGE" )
		End If
	Case "F"
		strMsg = SelectReturnString( "INPUT_FORMAT_MESSAGE" )
	Case "@"
		strMsg = SelectReturnString( "SET_MACRO_MESSAGE" )
	Case "!A"
		strMsg = "文書を増殖する倍数を入力してください。(キャンセルで中止)" & Chr(13) _
		& "対象文書が複数の場合は積算になります。"
	Case "!C","!M"
		strMsg = "文書反映先DBのサーバ名、ファイルパスを" & Chr(13) _
		& "セミコロン( ; )区切りで入力してください。(キャンセルで中止)" & Chr(13) _
		& "また、カレントDBを指定する場合はセミコロンのみ入力してください。"
	Case "*"
		strMsg = {文書抽出条件を入力してください。(キャンセルで中止)} & Chr(13) _
		& {・・・(ex) 『SELECT Form = "Memo"』}
	Case Else
		strMsg = ""
	End Select
	strData = objInputInfo.FOldValue
	Select Case strType
	Case "S","R","U","A","F"
		Call LineTabChange( 0, strData )
	Case "@"
		strData = "実行する式を入力してください。"
	Case "!A"
		strData = "1"
	Case "!C","!M"
		strData = "サーバ名、ファイルパスを入力してください。"
	Case "*"
		strData = "文書を抽出する式を入力してください。"
	Case "D","N"
	Case Else
		strData = ""
	End Select
	Call objInputInfo.InputInfo(strTitle, strMsg, strData)
	fncDataTypeSelect = 0
	Exit Function
ERR_HANDLE:
	Call OnErrorMsgDisp( "fncDataTypeSelect関数", Erl, Err, Error$ )
	fncDataTypeSelect = -1
	Exit Function
End Function
Function fncSetDataInput( objInputInfo As clsInputInfo, _
objDataSetPreparation As clsDataSetPreparation ) As Integer
	On Error Goto ERR_HANDLE
	Dim vInputEndFlag As Variant
	Dim varResult As Variant
	Dim strData As String
	Dim strType As String
	Dim intInputSize As Integer
	Dim intCustomFlg As Integer
	Dim intReturn As Integer
	fncSetDataInput = -1
	strType = fncSeparateProperty( objInputInfo.FProperty, 0 )
	Select Case strType
	Case "S","N","D","R","U","A","F","@","*","!A","!C","!M"
		Do
			vInputEndFlag = True
			intReturn = objInputInfo.fncPromptSet(4)
			If intReturn < 1 Then
				fncSetDataInput = 1
				Msgbox "データ変更を取りやめました。" , 48 , "変更中止"
				Exit Function
			Else
			End If
			strData = objInputInfo.InputValue
			intInputSize = InputDataByteCheck(strData)
			If intInputSize > 253 Then
				Msgbox SelectReturnString("INPUT_SIZE_ERROR_MESSAGE")_
				& "『" & strData & "』", 16, "INPUT ERROR"
				objInputInfo.InputInfoDefault = strData
				vInputEndFlag = False
			Elseif fncInputCheck( strType, strData ) = False Then
				Msgbox SelectReturnString("INPUT_ERROR_MESSAGE"), 16, "INPUT ERROR"
				objInputInfo.InputInfoDefault = strData
				vInputEndFlag = False
			Else
				If strType = "*" Then
					fncSetDataInput = 2
					Exit Function
				Else
					intCustomFlg = fncInputDataCustomize( objInputInfo, objDataSetPreparation )
					Select Case intCustomFlg
					Case 0
					Case 1
						vInputEndFlag = False
						objInputInfo.InputInfoDefault = strData
					Case Else
						fncSetDataInput = -1
						Exit Function
					End Select
				End If
			End If
		Loop While vInputEndFlag = False
	Case Else
		intCustomFlg = fncInputDataCustomize( objInputInfo, objDataSetPreparation )
		Select Case intCustomFlg
		Case 0
		Case 1
			fncSetDataInput = 1
			Exit Function
		Case Else
			fncSetDataInput = -1
			Exit Function
		End Select
	End Select
	fncSetDataInput = 0
	Exit Function
ERR_HANDLE:
	Call OnErrorMsgDisp( "fncSetDataInput関数", Erl, Err, Error$ )
	fncSetDataInput = -1
	Exit Function
End Function
Function fncInputDataCustomize( objInputInfo As clsInputInfo, _
objDataSetPreparation As clsDataSetPreparation ) As Integer
	On Error Goto ERR_HANDLE
	Dim dbCopy As NotesDatabase
	Dim varResult As Variant
	Dim varRet As Variant
	Dim strData As String
	Dim strType As String
	Dim strElement As String
	Dim blnRichSet As Boolean
	fncInputDataCustomize = -1
	strData = objInputInfo.InputValue
	strType = fncSeparateProperty( objInputInfo.FProperty, 0 )
	strElement = fncSeparateProperty( objInputInfo.FProperty, 1 )
	Set objDataSetPreparation = New clsDataSetPreparation
	Select Case strType
	Case "!A"
		Call objDataSetPreparation.GetCopyDB( ";" )
	Case "!C","!M"
		Call objDataSetPreparation.GetCopyDB( objInputInfo.InputValue )
		Set dbCopy = objDataSetPreparation.CopyDB
		If dbCopy Is Nothing Then
			Msgbox "指定のDBが取得できません。", 48 , "DB取得エラー"
			fncInputDataCustomize = 1
			Exit Function
			Elseif Msgbox( "文書反映先は以下のDBでよろしいですか？" & Chr(13)&Chr(13) _
			& "タイトル：" & dbCopy.Title & Chr(13) & _
			"サーバ名：" & dbCopy.Server & Chr(13) & _
		"ファイルパス：" & dbCopy.FilePath, 4+32+256, "反映先確認" ) = 7 Then
			fncInputDataCustomize = 1
			Exit Function
		Elseif Not dbCopy.CurrentAccessLevel = ACLLEVEL_MANAGER Then
			Msgbox "コピー先DBに管理者の権限がないため、" & Chr(13) _
			& "文書を反映できません。" , 16 , "権限不足"
			fncInputDataCustomize = 1
			Exit Function
		Else
		End If
	Case Else
	End Select
	Select Case strType
	Case "!D","!M"
		varRet = Evaluate( {@UserAccess( @DbName ; [DELETEDOCUMENTS] )} )
		If ( varRet(0) <> "1" ) Then
			Msgbox "文書を削除する権限がありません。" , 16 , "権限不足"
			fncInputDataCustomize = 1
			Exit Function
		Else
		End If
	Case Else
	End Select
	Select Case strType
	Case "!A"
		If Msgbox( "対象文書を" & Cstr(Clng(objInputInfo.InputValue)) _
		& "倍にして追加しますがよろしいですか？", 4+32+256, "倍数確認" ) = 7 Then
			fncInputDataCustomize = 1
			Exit Function
		Else
		End If
	Case Else
	End Select
	Select Case strType
	Case "S","V"
		If strElement = "" Then
			Call LineTabChange( 1, strData )
		Else
		End If
		varResult = fncArrayCreaData( 0, strData )
		Call objDataSetPreparation.SetInputData( varResult, strElement )
	Case "N"
		varResult = fncArrayCreaData( 1, strData )
		Call objDataSetPreparation.SetInputData( varResult, "" )
	Case "D","V-D"
		varResult = fncArrayCreaData( 2, strData )
		Call objDataSetPreparation.SetInputData( varResult, "" )
	Case "R","V-R"
		Call LineTabChange( 1, strData )
		Call objDataSetPreparation.CreateRichData( varResult )
		If RichReplace( strData, varResult ) = False Then
			fncInputDataCustomize = 1
			Exit Function
		Else
		End If
	Case "U","F"
		Call LineTabChange( 1, strData )
	Case "A"
		Call LineTabChange( 1, strData )
		If fncSeparateProperty( objInputInfo.FOldProperty, 0 ) = "R" Then
			Call objDataSetPreparation.CreateRichData( varResult )
			If RichReplace( strData, varResult ) = False Then
				fncInputDataCustomize = 1
				Exit Function
			Else
			End If
		Else
			varResult = fncArrayCreaData( 0, strData )
			Call objDataSetPreparation.SetInputData( varResult, "" )
		End If
	Case "!A"
		Call objDataSetPreparation.SetInputData( Clng(strData), "" )
	Case Else
		Call objDataSetPreparation.SetInputData( "", "" )
	End Select
	Select Case strType
	Case "@","!A","!C","!D","!M","!R"
		objDataSetPreparation.FName = ""
	Case Else
		objDataSetPreparation.FName = objInputInfo.FName
	End Select
	Select Case strType
	Case "E","U","F","@","!A","!C","!D","!M","!R"
		Call objDataSetPreparation.SetOperateType( strType, strData )
	Case "C"
		Call objDataSetPreparation.SetOperateType( strType, objInputInfo.ChangeProperty )
	Case Else
		Call objDataSetPreparation.SetOperateType( strType, strElement )
	End Select
	Select Case strType
	Case "@","!A","!C","!D","!M","!R"
		Call objDataSetPreparation.LogInfo( False, "" )
	Case Else
		Call objDataSetPreparation.LogInfo( objInputInfo.LogFlg, objInputInfo.LogPath )
	End Select
	objDataSetPreparation.AllSetFlg = objInputInfo.AllSetFlg
	fncInputDataCustomize = 0
	Exit Function
ERR_HANDLE:
	fncInputDataCustomize = -1
	Call OnErrorMsgDisp( "fncInputDataCustomize関数", Erl, Err, Error$ )
	Exit Function
End Function
Function fncInputDataReplace( objDataSetPreparation As clsDataSetPreparation, _
objBaseDBInfo As clsBaseDBInfo ) As Integer
	On Error Goto ERR_HANDLE
	Dim docTarget As NotesDocument
	Dim lngDcCnt As Long
	Dim lngLoop As Long
	Dim lngCopyCnt As Long
	Dim lngLargeCnt As Long
	Dim lngCopyLargeCnt As Long
	Dim lngSaveErrCnt As Long
	Dim lngSetErrCnt As Long
	Dim strType As String
	Dim intReturn As Integer
	Dim blnSetErrFlg As Boolean
	fncInputDataReplace = -1
	lngDcCnt = objBaseDBInfo.SelectDocCnt
	strType = objDataSetPreparation.SetTypeInfo
	If objDataSetPreparation.AllSetFlg = True Then
		Select Case strType
		Case "!A"
			For lngCopyCnt = 1 To objDataSetPreparation.CustomData.Values(0)
				Call objDataSetPreparation.AllDocCopyDel( 1, objBaseDBInfo.SelectDoc )
			Next
		Case "!C"
			Call objDataSetPreparation.AllDocCopyDel( 1, objBaseDBInfo.SelectDoc )
		Case "!D"
			Call objDataSetPreparation.AllDocCopyDel( 2, objBaseDBInfo.SelectDoc )
		Case "!M"
			Call objDataSetPreparation.AllDocCopyDel( 3, objBaseDBInfo.SelectDoc )
		Case Else
			Call objDataSetPreparation.AllDocChangeValue( objBaseDBInfo.SelectDoc )
		End Select
		lngSaveErrCnt = 0
		lngSetErrCnt = 0
	Else
		For lngLoop = 1 To lngDcCnt
			blnSetErrFlg = False
			Set docTarget = objBaseDBInfo.fncReturnDocNth( lngLoop )
			If ( lngLoop Mod 250 ) = 0 Then
				If ( lngLoop + 249 ) > lngDcCnt Then
					lngLargeCnt = lngDcCnt
				Else
					lngLargeCnt = lngLoop + 249
				End If
				Print Cstr( lngLoop ) & "～" & Cstr( lngLargeCnt ) & "件を処理中・・・"_
				& "全件数：" & Cstr( lngDcCnt ) & "件"
			Else
			End If
			If objDataSetPreparation.LogFlg = False Then
			Else
				intReturn = fncFieldDataLog( docTarget, Split( objDataSetPreparation.FName, ";" ) )
				If intReturn = 0 Then
				Else
					blnSetErrFlg = True
				End If
			End If
			Select Case strType
			Case "A"
				Call objDataSetPreparation.AddValue( docTarget )
			Case "F"
				Call objDataSetPreparation.SetFormat( docTarget, lngLoop )
			Case "@"
				intReturn = objDataSetPreparation.fncExecuteMacro( docTarget )
				If intReturn = 0 Then
				Else
					blnSetErrFlg = True
				End If
			Case "!A"
				lngCopyLargeCnt = 0
				For lngCopyCnt = 1 To objDataSetPreparation.CustomData.Values(0)
					If ( lngCopyCnt Mod 250 ) = 0 Then
						If ( lngCopyCnt + 249 ) > objDataSetPreparation.CustomData.Values(0) Then
							lngCopyLargeCnt = objDataSetPreparation.CustomData.Values(0)
						Else
							lngCopyLargeCnt = lngCopyCnt + 249
						End If
						Print Cstr( lngLoop ) & "件目 ⇒ " & Cstr( lngCopyCnt ) & "～" & Cstr( lngCopyLargeCnt ) & "件を増殖中・・・"_
						& "増殖件数：" & Cstr( objDataSetPreparation.CustomData.Values(0) ) & "件"
					Else
					End If
					intReturn = objDataSetPreparation.fncDocCopyDel( 1, docTarget )
					If intReturn = 0 Then
					Else
						lngSaveErrCnt = lngSaveErrCnt + 1
						Exit For
					End If
				Next
			Case "!C"
				intReturn = objDataSetPreparation.fncDocCopyDel( 1, docTarget )
				If intReturn = 0 Then
				Else
					lngSaveErrCnt = lngSaveErrCnt + 1
				End If
			Case "!D"
				intReturn = objDataSetPreparation.fncDocCopyDel( 2, docTarget )
				If intReturn = 0 Then
				Else
					lngSaveErrCnt = lngSaveErrCnt + 1
				End If
			Case "!M"
				intReturn = objDataSetPreparation.fncDocCopyDel( 3, docTarget )
				If intReturn = 0 Then
				Else
					lngSaveErrCnt = lngSaveErrCnt + 1
				End If
			Case "!R"
				If docTarget.ComputeWithForm( False, False ) = False Then
					blnSetErrFlg = True
				Else
				End If
			Case Else
				intReturn = objDataSetPreparation.ChangeValue( docTarget )
				If intReturn = 0 Then
				Else
					blnSetErrFlg = True
				End If
			End Select
			Select Case strType
			Case "!A","!C","!D","!M"
			Case Else
				If blnSetErrFlg = False Then
					If docTarget.Save( False, False ) = False Then
						lngSaveErrCnt = lngSaveErrCnt + 1
					End If
				Else
					lngSetErrCnt = lngSetErrCnt + 1
				End If
			End Select
		Next
	End If
	Call EndMsgDisp( strType, lngDcCnt, lngSaveErrCnt, lngSetErrCnt )
	Select Case strType
	Case "!D", "!M"
		fncInputDataReplace = 1
		Exit Function
	Case Else
	End Select
	fncInputDataReplace = 0
	Exit Function
ERR_HANDLE:
	fncInputDataReplace = -1
	Call OnErrorMsgDisp( "fncInputDataReplace関数", Erl, Err, Error$ )
	Exit Function
End Function

Function KeywordListReturn( strKeyIndex As String ) As Variant
	Dim vKeyIndex As Variant
	Dim strKeySet As String
	vKeyIndex = Split(strKeyIndex, "/")
	Forall tmpKeyIndex In vKeyIndex
		Select Case tmpKeyIndex
		Case "S"
			strKeySet = strKeySet & "S：文字列(Stringの略);"
		Case "D"
			strKeySet = strKeySet & "D：日付/時刻(Dateの略);"
		Case "N"
			strKeySet = strKeySet & "N：数値(Numberの略);"
		Case "V"
			strKeySet = strKeySet & "V：NULL(Voidの略);"
		Case "R"
			strKeySet = strKeySet & "R：リッチテキスト(RichTextの略);"
		Case "U"
			strKeySet = strKeySet & "U：値の検索・置換(Updateの略);"
		Case "A"
			strKeySet = strKeySet & "A：値の追加(Appendの略);"
		Case "E"
			strKeySet = strKeySet & "E：フィールドの消去(Eraseの略);"
		Case "F"
			strKeySet = strKeySet & "F：形式指定(Formatの略);"
		Case "S[N]"
			strKeySet = strKeySet & "S[N]：名前属性(Namesの略);"
		Case "S[NR]"
			strKeySet = strKeySet & "S[NR]：読者名属性(Names・Readersの略);"
		Case "S[NA]"
			strKeySet = strKeySet & "S[NA]：作成者名属性(Names・Authorsの略);"
		Case "V-D"
			strKeySet = strKeySet & "V-D：日付/時刻属性のNULL;"
		Case "V-R"
			strKeySet = strKeySet & "V-R：リッチテキスト属性のNULL;"
		Case "S[NRA]"
			strKeySet = strKeySet & "S[NRA]：読者名+作成者名属性;"
		Case "V[NRA]"
			strKeySet = strKeySet & "V[NRA]：読者名+作成者名属性NULL;"
		Case "V[N]"
			strKeySet = strKeySet & "V[N]：名前属性NULL;"
		Case "V[NR]"
			strKeySet = strKeySet & "V[NR]：読者名属性NULL;"
		Case "V[NA]"
			strKeySet = strKeySet & "V[NA]：作成者名属性NULL;"
		Case "C"
			strKeySet = strKeySet & "C：属性変更(Changeの略);"
		Case "[N]"
			strKeySet = strKeySet & "[N]：属性変更<名前>;"
		Case "[NR]"
			strKeySet = strKeySet & "[NR]：属性変更<読者名>;"
		Case "[NA]"
			strKeySet = strKeySet & "[NA]：属性変更<作成者名>;"
		Case "[NRA]"
			strKeySet = strKeySet & "[NRA]：属性変更<読者名+作成者名>;"
		Case "Z"
			strKeySet = strKeySet & "Z：特殊設定;"
		Case Else
		End Select
	End Forall
	KeywordListReturn = Arrayunique(Fulltrim(Split(strKeySet, ";")))
	Erase vKeyIndex
End Function

		strKata = "【日付/時刻のNULL】"
	Case "V-R"
		strKata = "【リッチテキストのNULL】"
	Case "U"
		strKata = "【値の検索・追加】"
	Case "A"
		strKata = "【値の追加】"
	Case "C"
		strKata = "【属性変更】"
	Case "F"
		strKata = "【形式指定】"
	Case Else
		strKata = ""
	End Select
	If strSubType <> "" Then
		strSubKata = ""
		If Instr( strSubType, "A" ) > 0 Then
			strSubKata = "Authors"
		End If
		If Instr( strSubType, "N" ) > 0 Then
			If strSubKata = "" Then
				strSubKata = "Names"
			Else
				strSubKata = strSubKata & ",Names"
			End If
		End If
		If Instr( strSubType, "R" ) > 0 Then
			If strSubKata = "" Then
				strSubKata = "Readers"
			Else
				strSubKata = strSubKata & ",Readers"
			End If
		End If
		If strSubKata = "" Then
		Else
			strKata = strKata & "(" & strSubKata & ")"
		End If
	Else
	End If
	fncTypeReturn = strKata
End Function
Function InputDataByteCheck( strData As String ) As Integer
	Dim strTmpData As String
	Dim strTmpKey As String
	Dim intDataNum As Integer
	Dim intSetCnt As Integer
	Dim intInputSize As Integer
	intDataNum = Len(strData)
	strTmpData = ""
	intInputSize = 0
	For intSetCnt = 1 To intDataNum
		strTmpKey = Mid(strData, intSetCnt, 1)
		Select Case Lenbp(strTmpKey)
		Case 2
			intInputSize = intInputSize + 3
		Case Else
			intInputSize = intInputSize + Lenbp(strTmpKey)
		End Select
	Next
	InputDataByteCheck = intInputSize
End Function

Sub LineTabChange( intChangeType As Integer, strData As String )
	Dim strTmpData As String
	Dim strTmpKey As String
	Dim intLength As Integer
	Dim intSetCnt As Integer
	intLength = Len(strData)
	If intLength = 0 Then
		Exit Sub
	Else
		strTmpData = ""
	End If
	Select Case intChangeType
	Case 0
		For intSetCnt = 1 To intLength
			strTmpKey = Mid(strData, intSetCnt, 1)
			Select Case strTmpKey
			Case Chr(13)
				strTmpData = strTmpData & "~"
				intSetCnt = intSetCnt + 1
			Case Chr(9)
				strTmpData = strTmpData & "|"
			Case Else
				strTmpData = strTmpData & strTmpKey
			End Select
		Next
		strData = strTmpData
	Case 1
		For intSetCnt = 1 To intLength
			strTmpKey = Mid(strData, intSetCnt, 1)
			Select Case strTmpKey
			Case "~"
				strTmpData = strTmpData & Chr(13)&Chr(10)
			Case "|"
				strTmpData = strTmpData & Chr(9)
			Case Else
				strTmpData = strTmpData & strTmpKey
			End Select
		Next
		strData = strTmpData
	Case Else
	End Select
End Sub
Function fncArrayCreaData( intType As Integer, strData As String ) As Variant
	On Error Goto ERR_HANDLE
	Dim DSetTime() As NotesDateTime
	Dim varResult As Variant
	Dim intSetCnt As Integer
	Select Case intType
	Case 1
		varResult = Evaluate("@TextToNumber(@Explode( """ & strData & """ ; "";"" ; 1 ))")
		fncArrayCreaData = varResult
		Erase varResult
	Case 2
		varResult = Split( strData, ";" )
		Redim DSetTime(Ubound(varResult)) As NotesDateTime
		For intSetCnt = 0 To Ubound(varResult)
			Set DSetTime(intSetCnt) = New NotesDateTime( varResult(intSetCnt) )
		Next
		fncArrayCreaData = DSetTime
		Erase varResult
	Case Else
		fncArrayCreaData = Split( strData, ";" )
	End Select
	Exit Function

	fncArrayCreaData = Split("")
	Exit Function
End Function
Public Function fncSeparateProperty( strProperty As String, intType As Integer ) As String

	End If

		If Instr(strType, "[") > 0 Then
			fncSeparateProperty = Strleft(strType, "[")
		Else
			fncSeparateProperty = strType
		End If
	Case 1

Function RichReplace( strResult As String, varRText As Variant ) As Boolean
	Dim ss As NotesSession
	Dim rtsStyle As NotesRichTextStyle
	Dim strList List As String
	Dim strDat As String
	Dim strSubData As String
	Dim strCode As String
	Dim strEleData As String
	Dim intNum As Integer
	Dim strTmp As String
	Set ss = New NotesSession
	intNum = 1
	RichReplace = False
	strDat = Left( strResult, 1 )
	Set rtsStyle = ss.CreateRichTextStyle( )
	With rtsStyle
		.Bold = False
		.Effects = 0
		.FontSize = 10
		.Italic = False
		.NotesColor = 0
		.NotesFont = 1
		.StrikeThrough = False
		.UnderLine = False
	End With
	Call varRText.AppendStyle( rtsStyle )
	While strDat <> ""
		If strDat = "[" Then
			strCode = Strconv(Mid(strResult, intNum+1, 2), 1+8)
			If ( strCode = "F*" ) Or ( strCode = "E*" ) Then
				intNum = intNum + 3
				strDat = Mid(strResult, intNum, 1)
				Do While True
					Select Case strDat
					Case "","]"
						strList(intNum) = strEleData
						strEleData = ""
						Exit Do
					Case "/"
						strList(intNum) = strEleData
						strEleData = ""
					Case Else
						strEleData = strEleData & strDat
					End Select
					intNum = intNum + 1
					strDat = Mid(strResult, intNum, 1)
				Loop
				Select Case strCode
				Case "F*"
					On Error Goto ELEMENT_ERROR
					Forall tmpDat In strList
						strTmp = Strconv(tmpDat, 1+8)
						If strTmp = "B" Then
							rtsStyle.Bold = True
						Elseif strTmp Like "E:*" Then
							rtsStyle.Effects = Cint(Mid(strTmp, 3))
						Elseif strTmp = "I" Then
							rtsStyle.Italic = True
						Elseif strTmp Like "C:*" Then
							rtsStyle.NotesColor = Cint(Mid(strTmp, 3))
						Elseif strTmp Like "F:*" Then
							rtsStyle.NotesFont = Cint(Mid(strTmp, 3))
						Elseif strTmp = "T" Then
							rtsStyle.StrikeThrough = True
						Elseif strTmp = "U" Then
							rtsStyle.UnderLine = True
						Elseif strTmp Like "S:*" Then
							rtsStyle.FontSize = Cint(Mid(strTmp, 3))
						Else
							Msgbox "属性の設定で入力ミスがあります。" & Chr(13)_
							& "下記の文字列を確認してください。" & Chr(13)&Chr(13)_
							& "[" & strCode & "]の設定  ⇒  入力ミスの属性：『" & strTmp & "』", 16, "InputError"
							Exit Function
						End If
					End Forall
					On Error Goto 0
				Case "E*"
					Forall tmpDat In strList
						strTmp = Strconv(tmpDat, 1+8)
						Select Case strTmp
						Case "D"
							With rtsStyle
								.Bold = False
								.Effects = 0
								.FontSize = 10
								.Italic = False
								.NotesColor = 0
								.NotesFont = 1
								.StrikeThrough = False
								.UnderLine = False
							End With
						Case "B"
							rtsStyle.Bold = False
						Case "E"
							rtsStyle.Effects = 0
						Case "S"
							rtsStyle.FontSize = 10
						Case "I"
							rtsStyle.Italic = False
						Case "C"
							rtsStyle.NotesColor = 0
						Case "F"
							rtsStyle.NotesFont = 1
						Case "T"
							rtsStyle.StrikeThrough = False
						Case "U"
							rtsStyle.UnderLine = False
						Case Else
							Msgbox "属性の設定で入力ミスがあります。" & Chr(13)_
							& "下記の文字列を確認してください。" & Chr(13)&Chr(13)_
							& "[" & strCode & "]の設定  ⇒  入力ミスの属性：『" & strTmp & "』", 16, "InputError"
							Exit Function
						End Select
					End Forall
				Case Else
				End Select
				If strSubData <> "" Then
					Call varRText.AppendText( strSubData )
					strSubData = ""
				End If
				Call varRText.AppendStyle( rtsStyle )
				Erase strList
			Elseif Mid(strResult, intNum+1, 1) = "/" Then
				intNum = intNum + 2
				strDat = Mid(strResult, intNum, 1)
				Do While True
					Select Case strDat
					Case "","]"
						Exit Do
					Case "/"
						strList(intNum) = strEleData
						strEleData = ""
					Case Else
						strEleData = strEleData & strDat
					End Select
					intNum = intNum + 1
					strDat = Mid(strResult, intNum, 1)
				Loop
				If strSubData <> "" Then
					Call varRText.AppendText( strSubData )
					strSubData = ""
				End If
				Forall tmpPath In strList
					On Error 4225 Goto FILE_ERROR
					Call varRText.EmbedObject( EMBED_ATTACHMENT, "", tmpPath )
					On Error Goto 0
				End Forall
				strEleData = ""
				Erase strList
			Else
				Select Case strDat
				Case "~"
					strSubData = strSubData & Chr(13)&Chr(10)
				Case "|"
					strSubData = strSubData & Chr(9)
				Case Else
					strSubData = strSubData & strDat
				End Select
			End If
		Else
			Select Case strDat
			Case "~"
				strSubData = strSubData & Chr(13)&Chr(10)
			Case "|"
				strSubData = strSubData & Chr(9)
			Case Else
				strSubData = strSubData & strDat
			End Select
		End If
		intNum = intNum + 1
		strDat = Mid(strResult, intNum, 1)
	Wend
	If strSubData <> "" Then
		Call varRText.AppendText( strSubData )
	End If
	RichReplace = True
	Exit Function
ELEMENT_ERROR:
	Msgbox "属性の設定で入力ミスがあります。" & Chr(13)_
	& "下記の文字列を確認してください。" & Chr(13)&Chr(13)_
	& "[" & strCode & "]の設定  ⇒  入力ミスの属性：『" & strTmp & "』", 16, "InputError"
	Exit Function
FILE_ERROR:
	Msgbox "ファイル添付時にエラーが発生しました。" & Chr(13)_
	& "指定したファイルが存在しないか、またはパスの入力ミスがありますので" & Chr(13)_
	& "確認後、再度実行してください。", 16, "FileError"
	Exit Function
End Function
Function fncInputCheck( strType As String, strData As String ) As Boolean
	Dim varResult As Variant
	Dim strDataPiece As String
	Dim strPiece As String
	Dim intSetNum As Integer
	fncInputCheck = False
	Select Case strType
	Case "!A"
		If Isnumeric(strData) = False Then
			fncInputCheck = False
		Elseif Clng(strData) <= 0 Then
			fncInputCheck = False
		Elseif Instr(strData, ".") > 0 Then
			fncInputCheck = False
		Else
			fncInputCheck = True
		End If
	Case "U","!C","!M"
		varResult = Split(strData, ";", -1, 5)
		If Ubound(varResult) = 1 Then
			fncInputCheck = True
		Else
			fncInputCheck = False
		End If
		Erase varResult
	Case "N","D"
		strDataPiece = strData
		Do While strDataPiece <> ""
			intSetNum = Instr(strDataPiece,";")
			Select Case intSetNum
			Case 0
				strPiece = strDataPiece
				strDataPiece = ""
			Case 1
				strPiece = "ERROR"
				strDataPiece = ""
			Case Else
				strPiece = Left( strDataPiece, intSetNum-1 )
				strDataPiece = Right( strDataPiece, Len(strDataPiece)-intSetNum )
				If strDataPiece = "" Then
					strPiece = "ERROR"
				End If
			End Select
			If (( strType = "N" ) And ( Isnumeric( strPiece ) = False ))_
			Or (( strType = "D" ) And ( Isdate( strPiece ) = False )) Then
				fncInputCheck = False
				Exit Do
			Else
				fncInputCheck = True
			End If
		Loop
	Case Else
		fncInputCheck = True
	End Select
End Function
Function fncExistType( lngFProperty As Long, varFValue As Variant ) As String

			strDefault = "V-R"

			strDefault = "R"
		End If

		strDefault = "N"
	Case 1024
		If varFValue.text = "" Then
			strDefault = "V-D"
		Else
			strDefault = "D"
		End If
	Case Else
		If varFValue.text = "" Then
			strDefault = "V"
		Else
			strDefault = "S"
		End If
	End Select
	If varFValue.IsNames = True Then
		strSpecialProperty = "N"
	End If
	If varFValue.IsReaders = True Then
		strSpecialProperty = strSpecialProperty & "R"
	End If
	If varFValue.IsAuthors = True Then
		strSpecialProperty = strSpecialProperty & "A"
	End If
	If strSpecialProperty <> "" Then
		strDefault = strDefault & "[" & strSpecialProperty & "]"
	End If
	fncExistType = strDefault
End Function

Function fncFieldDataLog( docTarget As NotesDocument, varFieldList As Variant ) As Integer
	On Error Goto ERR_HANDLE
	Dim varResult As Variant
	Dim varItem As Variant
	Dim itmLog As NotesItem
	Dim strDataInfo As String
	Dim intDataType As Integer
	fncFieldDataLog = -1
	Forall tmpFName In varFieldList
		Set varItem = docTarget.GetFirstItem( tmpFName )
		strDataInfo = strDataInfo & Chr(13)&Chr(10)&Chr(13)&Chr(10) _
		& "フィールド名：" & tmpFName & Chr(13)&Chr(10)
		If varItem Is Nothing Then
			strDataInfo = strDataInfo & "型：[NOTHING]" & Chr(13)&Chr(10) & "値：[NOTHING]"
		Else
			intDataType = varItem.Type
			strDataInfo = strDataInfo & "型：" & fncGetItemTypeName( intDataType ) & Chr(13)&Chr(10)
			If intDataType = 1 Then
				strDataInfo = strDataInfo & "値：『" & varItem.GetUnformattedText( ) & "』"
			Else
				strDataInfo = strDataInfo & "値：『" & varItem.text & "』"
			End If
		End If
	End Forall
	varResult = Evaluate( {"◆更新時間：" + @Text(@Now([SERVERTIME]:[LOCALTIMEONERROR])) + @Char(0) + "◆更新者ID：" + @Name( [CN]; @UserName )} )
	strDataInfo = varResult(0) & strDataInfo
	Set itmLog = docTarget.GetFirstItem( "$DataChangeLog$" )
	If itmLog Is Nothing Then
	Else
		strDataInfo = itmLog.text & Chr(13)&Chr(10)&Chr(13)&Chr(10) & strDataInfo
	End If
	Call docTarget.ReplaceItemValue( "$DataChangeLog$", strDataInfo )
	fncFieldDataLog = 0
	Exit Function
ERR_HANDLE:
	fncFieldDataLog = -1
	Exit Function
End Function
Sub MakeMsg( objDocElement As clsDocElement, varFName As Variant )
	Dim strMsg As String
	Dim strFValue As String
	Dim strFName As String
	strMsg = "フィールド名" & Space$(10) & Chr(9) & "型" & Space$(15) & Chr(9) & "値" & Chr(13) & _
	"------------------------------------------------------------------------" & Chr(13)
	Forall tmpFName In varFName
		Call objDocElement.GetFInfo( Cstr( tmpFName ), 0 )
		If Len( tmpFName ) > 15 Then
			strFName = Left( tmpFName, 15 ) & "･･･"
		Else
			strFName = Left( tmpFName & Space$( 15 ), 15 )
		End If
		If objDocElement.FValue Is Nothing Then
			strMsg = strMsg & strFName & Chr(9) & "[NOTHING]" & Chr(13)
		Else
			Call objDocElement.GetFInfo( Cstr( tmpFName ), 1 )
			If objDocElement.FProperty = 1 Then
				strFValue = objDocElement.FValue.GetUnFormattedText( )
			Else
				strFValue = objDocElement.FValue.text
			End If
			If  Len( strFValue ) > 20 Then
				strFValue = Left( strFValue, 20 ) & "･･･"
			Else
			End If
			Call LineTabChange( 0, strFValue )
			strMsg = strMsg & strFName & Chr(9) & _
			Left( fncGetItemTypeName( objDocElement.FProperty ) & Space$( 15 ), 15 ) & Chr(9) _
			& "『" & strFValue & "』" & Chr(13)
		End If
	End Forall
	Msgbox "指定したフィールドは以下の状態です。" & Chr(13) & Chr(13)_
	& strMsg & Chr(13) _
	& "※ 改行はチルダ( ~ )、タブは縦棒( | )に変換しています。", 64, "フィールド確認"
End Sub
Sub EndMsgDisp( strType As String, lngDcCnt As Long, _
lngSaveErrCnt As Long, lngSetErrCnt As Long )
	Dim strEndMsg As String
	Dim strReplaceWord As String
	Select Case strType
	Case "E"
		strEndMsg = "フィールド#消去"
	Case "!A"
		strEndMsg = "文書#増殖"
	Case "!C"
		strEndMsg = "文書#コピー"
	Case "!D"
		strEndMsg = "文書#削除"
	Case "!M"
		strEndMsg = "文書#移動"
	Case "!R"
		strEndMsg = "文書#更新"
	Case Else
		strEndMsg = "データ#設定"
	End Select
	If ( lngSaveErrCnt > 0 ) Or ( lngSetErrCnt > 0 ) Then
		strReplaceWord = "の"
	Else
		strReplaceWord = "を"
	End If
	strEndMsg = Strleft(strEndMsg, "#") & strReplaceWord & Strrightback(strEndMsg, "#")
	If ( lngSaveErrCnt > 0 ) Or ( lngSetErrCnt > 0 ) Then
		Select Case strType
		Case "E","!A","!C","!D","!M"
			If lngDcCnt = 1 Then
				Msgbox strEndMsg & "に失敗しました。", 48, "ERROR"
			Else
				Msgbox Cstr(lngDcCnt) & "件中" & Cstr(lngSaveErrCnt) & "件の文書が"_
				& strEndMsg & "に失敗しました。", 48, "ERROR"
			End If
		Case Else
			If lngDcCnt = 1 Then
				If lngSaveErrCnt > 0 Then
					Msgbox "文書を保存できませんでした。", 48, "ERROR"
				Else
					Msgbox strEndMsg & "に失敗しました。", 48, "ERROR"
				End If
			Else
				Msgbox Cstr(lngDcCnt) & "件中" & Cstr(lngSetErrCnt) & "件の文書が"_
				& strEndMsg & "に失敗し、" & Chr(13)_
				& Cstr(lngSaveErrCnt) & "件が保存できませんでした。", 48, "ERROR"
			End If
		End Select
	Else
		Msgbox strEndMsg & "しました。", 64, "変更終了"
	End If
End Sub

  Return: 基準日から○○日後の営業日を戻り値として返す。
  Validation: Require valid calendar date; Use structured error handler
  Error Handling: On Error Goto ERR_HANDLE
  Source:
    Function funcEigyobiGet(strMotoDay As String, intAddNissu As Integer) As String
    	Dim ss As NotesSession
    	Dim dbCur As NotesDatabase
    	Dim viwSyuku As NotesView
    	Dim docSyuku As NotesDocument
    	Dim DtmTime As NotesDateTime
    	Dim varSyukuDay As Variant
    	Dim strChkDay As String
    	Dim intCount As Integer
    	Dim intAdd As Integer
    	On Error Goto ERR_HANDLE
    	intCount = 1
    	intAdd = 1
    	If Isdate(strMotoDay) = False Then
    		funcEigyobiGet = ""
    		Exit Function
    	Elseif intAddNissu = 0 Then
    		funcEigyobiGet = strMotoDay
    		Exit Function
    	Elseif intAddNissu < 0 Then
    		intAdd = -1
    	Else
    	End If
    	Set ss = New NotesSession
    	Set dbCur = ss.CurrentDatabase
    	Set viwSyuku = dbCur.GetView("viwSyukuCalendar")
    	Set docSyuku = viwSyuku.GetFirstDocument
    	If docSyuku Is Nothing Then
    		varSyukuDay = Split("")
    	Else
    		varSyukuDay = docSyuku.SyukuDay
    	End If
    	Set DtmTime = New NotesDateTime( strMotoDay )
    	Do While intCount <= Abs(intAddNissu)
    		Call DtmTime.AdjustDay( intAdd )
    		strChkDay = DtmTime.DateOnly
    		If (Weekday(strChkDay) = 1) Or (Weekday(strChkDay) = 7) Then
    		Elseif Isnull(Arraygetindex( varSyukuDay, strChkDay )) = False Then
    		Else
    			intCount = intCount + 1
    		End If
    	Loop
    	funcEigyobiGet = DtmTime.DateOnly
    	Exit Function
    ERR_HANDLE:
    	funcEigyobiGet = ""
    	Exit Function
    End Function

Option Public
Option Declare
Use "clsAddressInfo"


Dim strErrNo As String
Dim strErrLine As String
